units.source_text: 此时三皇子（即匂皇子）十五岁，薰君十四岁。

en.t: At this time, the Third Prince, that is Prince Niou, was fifteen years old, and Lord Kaoru was fourteen.

units.source_text: 可知从第四十回至今，相隔已有八年。

en.t: This shows that eight years had already passed since Chapter Forty.

units.source_text: 本回从薰君十四岁的春天写到二十岁的正月为止。

en.t: This chapter covers the period from the spring when Lord Kaoru was fourteen until the first month of the year when he was twenty.
